svg.title: B2 hemispherical diffuse-sky irradiance
svg.desc: Selected order-4 Algorithm32 plus the measured seventeen-condition 360 to 720 nanometer diffuse-sky irradiance curve, with nine optional regenerated comparison-model curves.

svg.text: Algorithm32 is the selected cumulative-through-order-4 result. Bruneton Figure 8 is the primary published plot.
The nine comparison-model curves are optional local regenerations from the pinned published code, not source-authored numeric Figure 8 values.
Measurement and Algorithm32 use the same B1 directional field integration and exclude direct Sun. B2 is an integral transform of B1, not independent evidence.
